name: Guild Raid
reuse_rule: Characters may be reused between token-limited attempts.
restrictions: A maximum of five characters may be deployed.
Characters sharing a faction with the boss or supporting battle cannot be deployed.
Bosses have the Immune trait, so effect eligibility must be verified per mechanic.
Guild Raid API access requires the Guild Raid key scope and guild leadership permission.
scoring_objectives: Deal as much boss damage as possible within the battle turn limit.
Contribute damage toward the guild's cumulative boss defeat and season total.

sources.notes: Mechanics and restrictions; unofficial community wiki reviewed 2026-08-05.
Official API access and scope requirements.
